slides.title: The Reporter suspended
slides.body: Ethiopia's Media Authority suspended The Reporter indefinitely from Nov 2, AFP and Addis Standard report.

slides.title: The stated reasons
slides.body: The Authority cites content it says contradicts national interests and "unbalanced and biased" reports.

slides.title: What is still unknown
slides.body: Addis Standard says no examples were given. No response from The Reporter in these reports.

slides.title: Protect press freedom and fair process.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: AFP via Africanews; Addis Standard via allAfrica · Nov 2-3, 2026
